card.name: Just before numbers in study results
card.fires_on: The space or digit position just before a number in a reported study finding, such as a year, percent change, or risk figure. Also fires on a few nearby spots in such sentences, like "Meta-Analysis" or "of" before age.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: The blank or digit slot right ahead of a year, sample size or percent in a study summary.

modes.label: Study-citation words
modes.description: Words in a citation or risk statement that come just before the result or a number.

card.writes: It lowers environment and genetics words, so it steers away from naming causes like genes or surroundings after study numbers.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a research summary where a number is about to appear, such as a percent change or a year.
